'''Mistress Ahan''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]] and the mother of [[Kenley Ahan]].

== Appearance ==
She is handsome with streaks of white in her nearly black braid.

== Activities ==
Her son goes with [[Perrin Aybara]] and is killed when the Trollocs ambush Perrin's group.{{ref/book|4|40}} She calls out for Kenley when the survivors return to Emond's Field.{{ref/book|4|43}}
